newsitem.title: GERMANY: German winter crops developing normally.
newsitem.headline: German winter crops developing normally.

text.p: German crops are progressing well amid typical rain and temperature patterns for the time of year, the DWD meteorological office said in a weekly report.
"Fields are too wet in some regions, which makes soils hard to drive on, but conditions elsewhere are normal," a DWD source said.
Barley, rye, and rapeseed were growing according to plan while some winter wheat was still being sown.
Maize and beet harvests were being completed ahead of potentially damaging night frosts.
DWD forecast rain and average maximum day temperatures between 10 and 13 degrees in the week to Nov 6.
It had recorded eight to 12 degrees in the week Oct 24-30, with southwestern spikes of 15-17 degrees. -Vera Eckert, Hamburg newsroom +49-40-41903275
